description: This donut chart, titled "Task Type," visually represents the distribution of two distinct task categories within the context of generative AI's use in journalism. The chart is composed of two slices: the larger, red-colored segment, labeled "Article generation (83.2%)," and the smaller, yellow-colored segment, labeled "Headline generation (16.8%)." The percentages are explicitly stated outside the chart, corresponding to each respective slice. The chart includes a central title and no legend is required as the labels are directly associated with their corresponding segments. The slices are arranged in a descending order of size, with the article generation category occupying the majority of the ring.
